args.question: Why did the three earlier parties never come out of Manufactory Nine, and why can Ode Marran remember every turn of the loop when they cannot? Explain the mechanism. Cite the excerpts.

label: Ask the book
output:
The three earlier parties never left Manufactory Nine because they are caught in a time loop that lasts slightly less than one hour [2]. When the loop ends, anyone inside who cannot "feel" the loop forgets the entire turn and is reset to the threshold, forced to live the hour fresh again [2]. Consequently, these parties are not dead, but are "still walking in" and have been doing so for nine years [2].

The mechanism of the loop is as follows:
*   **The Cause:** The Lumen Concern was digging for lumen when they struck "the Whole," which caused space to fold and time to catch [5]. This "splinter" in the rock causes space to fold and time to loop [5].
*   **The Reset:** Every hour, the loop "turns" [3]. For those who cannot hold the "deep Facets back," the turn resets them to the start of the loop (such as the threshold or the top of the stairs) and wipes their memory of the previous turn [2, 7].
*   **Ode Marran's Memory:** Unlike the others, Odeline Marran can remember every turn because she is one of the few people the loop cannot reset [7]. She has been living the same hour for nine years [6].
